name: How long does a quadriplegia injury lawsuit typically take?
description: The duration varies greatly, from a year or two for settlements to several years for complex cases requiring trial.

mainEntity.name: How long does a quadriplegia injury lawsuit typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a quadriplegia injury lawsuit can vary significantly depending on the complexity of the case, the extent of injuries, and whether it settles out of court or goes to trial. Some cases may resolve within a year or two through negotiation, while others, particularly those requiring extensive discovery or litigation, can take several years. Your lawyer can provide a more specific timeframe based on the unique details of your situation.
